newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: C&W unit to sign 1.174 bln peso escrow pacts.
newsitem.headline: C&W unit to sign 1.174 bln peso escrow pacts.

text.p: Eastern Telecommunications Philippines Inc, a unit of Cable & Wireless Plc, said on Monday it will execute escrow agreements with three banks for 1.174 billion pesos.
Eastern president Melquiades Gutierrez said in a statement the agreements will be signed on Tuesday with Metropolitan Bank & Trust Co, Bank of Philippine Islands and the International Exchange Bank.
The escrow accounts are being opened to comply with a requirement of the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC).

The NTC granted an international gateway facility licence to Eastern on condition it would put up at least 300,000 fixed phone lines. The fixed lines will be laid by a subsidiary of Eastern, Telecommunications Technologies Philippines Inc and the NTC had said the firm should open an escrow account putting in 20 percent of the project cost.
Gutierrez said the escrow deposits are funded through the present 294 million peso paid-in capital of TTPI and through Eastern's retained earnings.
ETPI is also set to deposit a performance bond of 500 million pesos as required by the NTC.
